name: DateTimePicker
purpose: Capture a date and a time together in one control.
intent: A Date Picker and a Time Picker joined into a single field over one Date value.

figmaSource.variants: context (default | inline) x size (sm | md | lg)

parts.date-picker: a date-picker instance (240px) - the left half.
parts.divider: a 1px rule between the halves; in code the two field borders collapse into one shared divider.
parts.time-picker: a time-picker instance (240px) - the right half.

figmaSource.notes: WIP in Figma: only context x size is defined (no combined open/disabled/hover/filled states) - interaction states come from the inner pickers. The set is 480px (two 240px halves). In code the control composes the DatePicker and TimePicker organisms over one shared Date; the joined look is achieved by pulling the two field frames together (negative margin) and squaring their inner corners.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: the labelled combined control; data-size, data-context

anatomy.name: date
anatomy.description: the date half (calendar popup); inner corners squared

anatomy.name: time
anatomy.description: the time half (hours/minutes/AM-PM popup); pulled in to share the divider

onChange.description: Called with the combined value when either half changes.

semantic.sharedDivider: the two field borders collapse via margin-inline-start: calc(-1 * --border-width-sm)
semantic.innerCorners: squared (border radius 0) so only the outer corners keep the Text Field radius

tokens.note: All field, popup, and calendar tokens come from the composed DatePicker / TimePicker. Date/Time Picker only adds the join (negative margin + squared inner corners).

accessibility.label: aria-label or aria-labelledby on the group
accessibility.halves: each half is an independent field with its own accessible name (dateLabel / timeLabel), role=dialog popup, and keyboard model
accessibility.note: See Date Picker and Time Picker for the per-half ARIA and keyboard details.

behaviorRules: Compose a DatePicker (left) and a TimePicker (right) over one shared Date value.
Picking a date keeps the current time (else midnight); confirming a time keeps the current date (else today).
Fire onChange with the combined Date whenever either half changes.
Pass size, context, disabled, invalid, and locale to both halves.
Pass min/max/isDateDisabled/weekStartsOn/today to the calendar and minuteStep to the time selector.
Join the halves visually: collapse the shared border and square the inner corners.
compositionRules: Compose the DatePicker and TimePicker organisms; do not reimplement their fields or popups.
Give the group an accessible name; give each half its own label.
contentRules: Provide per-half placeholders and formats as needed.
responsiveRules: Two 240px halves (480px total); each half's popup repositions to avoid viewport overflow.
themeRules: All tokens come from the composed pickers; do not add raw color/typography.
Dark theme is supported through the generated token variables.
implementationNotes: React and TypeScript; React.forwardRef on the root.
The joined look depends on each picker rendering its field frame as the direct child of its root.
No MUI, no Tailwind, no hardcoded colors/typography/spacing.
WIP: mirrors the current Figma (context x size); combined states will follow the inner pickers.
do: Use for a date + time together.
Give the group and each half an accessible name.
Constrain dates via the calendar pass-throughs.
dont: Use for only a date or only a time.
acceptanceCriteria: Renders a date field and a time field in a labelled group.
Selecting a date keeps the time; confirming a time keeps the date; onChange gets the combined Date.
Applies size and context on the group.
Joins the halves (collapsed border + squared inner corners).
Does not use MUI or Tailwind.
